# Tuya Wi-Fi Devices

Read status and control mapped capabilities on compatible Tuya local-TCP devices through Muse Home Link (TinyTuya), only with a known protocol version, existing device ID and local key, and an exact model datapoint schema. Writes are limited to known mapped datapoints; unknown datapoints are never probed by trial-and-error writes. Where a matching device-specific skill exists it is preferred — the skill names compatible eufy RoboVacs as the example.
